text:
Aisha Khan: quick FYI — CobaltCommerce onboarding health alert: p99 latency spiking to ~1.4s on short chat completions and token spend is trending +28% month-over-month. I reviewed traces; a lot of traffic is going to rw-instruct-13b (hosted) and falling back to dedicated rw-instruct-13b-pt when quota hits. thinking a conservative plan: 1) canary swap to rw-instruct-7b-q4 for short completions 2) add route rule to prefer dedicated for low-latency critical routes 3) enable prefix caching for repeated prompts. anyone see blockers?

Marco Li: agree with canary. rw-instruct-7b-q4 has ~35-40% cost reduction in our bench, p99 +~60-80ms vs 13b in same infra. suggestion: start with 5% traffic, monitor quality evals. also recommend token trimming via prompt template changes — small wins.

Devon R.: latency delta noted. need to confirm KV cache is warm on dedicated pool to avoid cold p99. can we add a warm-up job that primes top 200 prefixes? ops-bot can schedule. also what’s the SLA sensitivity window for Cobalt?

Leah Ortiz: Cobalt renewal flagged as medium risk in 3mo if costs not reduced. I already have an enablement slot with them Wed 10am. plan: present cost/latency tradeoffs, show quick canary results, and capture customer acceptance for model swap. will collect 3 representative prompts beforehand.

Aisha Khan: good. ops-bot — can you spin a 5% canary, route rule, and a warm-up job? include alert when quality (BLEU/ROUGE proxy) drops >3% or p99 increases >200ms.

ops-bot: Deploy request acknowledged. Creating canary: route_policy=cobalt-ccn/canary-7b-q4, traffic=5%, fallback=rw-instruct-13b-hosted. Warm-up job scheduled: primes top-200 prefixes over 10m to dedicated pool. Alerts set: p99_delta>200ms, quality_delta<-3%. Link: https://console.redwood/inbox/canaries/1738801234

Marco Li: for QA capture — add a lightweight eval harness that runs the 3 customer prompts and our golden responses. snippet: ```json
{"canary": "cobalt-7b-q4", "evals": ["promptA","promptB","promptC"], "threshold_pct": 97}
```

Devon R.: I'll watch infra metrics: gpu_util, kv_hit_rate, serve_latency_p50/p95/p99. if kv_hit_rate < 60% after warm-up, we'll pause and increase warm-up.

Leah Ortiz: I’ll prep the enablement deck and send a short survey after the session to capture acceptance + subtle regression feedback. also will ask them to share any high-value prompt patterns we should prioritize for caching.

Aisha Khan: next steps: Marco to deploy canary and eval harness (today EOD), Devon to monitor infra & adjust warm-up (24h), Leah to run enablement with Cobalt and collect prompts (Wed 10am), I’ll follow up for renewal touchpoint notes and propose pricing offset options if we hit ~20–30% cost savings. keep thread updated. :thumbsup:

Marco Li: done — canary config pushed, eval harness kicking off every 10m. link: https://ci.redwood/builds/ccn-canary-1738801234

Devon R.: monitoring live. initial kv_hit_rate at 82%, p99 ~+70ms vs baseline. no alerts yet.

Leah Ortiz: confirmed with Cobalt PO — they’re comfortable trying 7b-q4 for short replies. asked for rollback plan and a checklist; they want a 48h review window. I sent the prompts.

Aisha Khan: great. I'll summarize outcomes after 48h and propose opt-in routing for their production traffic. leaving here for updates.

ops-bot: Canary complete at 5% after 48h. quality_delta=-0.7% (within threshold). cost_reduction_estimate=32%. p99_delta=+85ms. No escalation triggered.

Marco Li: summary: canary successful. recommended next move: roll to 30% over next 24h, enable auto-prefix caching for top 500 prompts, and create a dedicated routing policy pinned to their dedicated pool for critical endpoints.

Aisha Khan: tagging follow-ups for renewal play: Leah to include case study numbers in renewal deck; Marco to prepare rollback & metrics dashboard link; Devon to confirm steady-state kv_hit_rate >75% after scale.

Leah Ortiz: got it. putting renewal notes in Gainsight and scheduling 1:1 with Cobalt PO.

Devon R.: will validate metrics at 30% traffic. will post results in this thread.

Aisha Khan: thanks team — closing this thread after 72h final report. :rocket:
